She smile for church. She no let anybody see her pain. But inside, her mind no rest at all. E dey race like motor for express road.
No speed limit. No exit. No brake. Fast, loud, whole night, round and round till first light for morning.
Last last Mommy stand up. She write everything. She report am to the people wey get power for her town. And people talk say,
You dey do too much. E don do. Calm down. Leave am.
Why you dey make am hard?
Al talk say she carry am pass limit when she drive that far. Another one talk say her head don go. Na so dem talk.

That night Mommy check the door lock, check am again, and again one more time. She lie down awake dey listen, every breath soft and deep.
Lord, I dey do too much?
Mommy strong. Mommy get liver. Na true. But Mommy na human being. And tonight, she dey fear too.
For morning Mommy make decision for herself. She go see Ms. Naomi, counsellor, for help.
Waiting room get fish tank, clipboard, biro. Mommy hold am long time. Then she hold am again.
Ms. Naomi talk soft, tissue dey near. She ask wetin she dey ask everybody, eye to eye.
You dey feel safe for house?
Mommy think about the noise, her pikin dem, the mornings, the shoes and the toys.
Inside my house, yes. Behind my front door. Na when we comot outside.
And you dey feel safe for your community too?
Mommy quiet for long time. Then she talk the truth.
No. I no dey feel safe. I no dey feel safe for my community. I no feel say I fit keep my pikin dem safe.

Tell me that same day. We go write wetin happen, who dey there, wetin dem talk.
